name: o68728

schema.title: application manifest
schema.description: In the application manifest a developer defines the application, its dependencies on other applications, services and environment variables that should be set. The application manifest is a JSON file. While the two required values are located in the root object, all deployment information is located under the ```deployment``` key. This way, applications written in NodeJS can reuse their existing package.json file as their application manifest by simply adding the ```deployment``` section.

name.description: Identifier for the application. Must be unique in a release. This value is used to identify an application throughout push2cloud, such as in `appConnections`, the [release manifest](release_manifest.md) and the [deployment manifest](deployment_manifest.md).

version.description: The version of your application. Use [semver](http://semver.org/). The version is used in certain [workflows](workflows.md) to determine if an update is required.

deployment.description: the entrypoint for all deployment information

memory.description: the amount of memory the app requires, e.g.: 128M, 1G

disk.description: the amount of disk the app requires, e.g.: 128M, 1G

startTimeout.description: how long the app can take to start before it is considered an error

stageTimeout.description: how long the app can take to stage before it is considered an error

gracePeriod.description: how long the app has to run without crashing to be considered successfully started

path.description: which folder/file should be used for deployment. Useful for java applications. Similar to [path in CloudFoundry manifests](http://docs.cloudfoundry.org/devguide/deploy-apps/manifest.html#path).

appBits.description: Alias for path. Will be overwritten by path.

env.description: environment variables to set/substitue for this app

serviceBinding.description: names of services this app needs connections to

scripts.description: scripts that are used in workflows during the apps deployment

appConnections.description: names of other apps this app needs connections to

urls.description: inject the connection information additonally with the following key and with value as a suffix to the URL

injectCredentials.description: controls the injection of _USERNAME and _PASSWORD credentials for this connection

description:
The **my-node-service** application, currently at version **2.3.1**, is provisioned to run with **512 M** of memory and **1 G** of disk space across **two instances**. It is allowed a **start‑up timeout of 120 seconds**, a **staging timeout of 300 seconds**, and must stay running without crashes for at least **30 seconds** before being considered successfully started. Deployment will use the Cloud Foundry Node.js buildpack located at **https://github.com/cloudfoundry/nodejs-buildpack.git**, and the executable artefact is the file **dist/app.js**. Environment variables for this service are set to **NODE_ENV=production** and **API_KEY=abc123xyz**. The application declares dependencies on the services **redis-cache** and **mongo-db**, and includes scripted steps for packaging – running **npm ci** followed by **npm run build** – as well as a deployment‑stage script that simply echoes “Deploying application”.

For inter‑service connectivity, **my-node-service** requires two app connections. It connects to **auth-service** with credential injection enabled; the connection supplies two URLs, **BASE_URL** set to **/auth** and **TOKEN_ENDPOINT** set to **/auth/token**. It also connects to **logging-service** without injecting credentials, exposing a single URL **LOG_URL** mapped to **/logs**. All of these settings together define the complete deployment manifest for the service.
